name: Serre Chevalier
description: Serre Chevalier stretches across 4 valley villages between Briancon (UNESCO-listed, highest city in France) and La Salle-les-Alpes. The ski area is 250km across larch-forested mountainsides with a southeast aspect — excellent sun, snow preservation, and tree-lined skiing that's rare in the southern Alps. Best value in the southern Alps. The village of Briancon is a fortified city founded in the 13th century, a UNESCO World Heritage site.

overview.atmosphere: Sun-soaked, tree-lined runs across 250km. 13th-century Briancon (UNESCO) valley town. Highest and sunniest city in France.

when_to_go.north_facing_slopes: Southeast-facing = maximum winter sun. Briancon is the highest and sunniest city in France (300+ sunny days/year).

beyond_skiing.non_ski_activities: Paragliding, via ferrata, whitewater sports (spring), yoga, massage, snowshoeing through larch forests

by_train.station: Briancon (TGV from Paris, direct in winter)

villages.name: Briancon
villages.character: UNESCO World Heritage fortified city (founded 13th century). Highest city in France. Full services — shops, restaurants, bars, hospitals, train station. Historic old town with cobbled streets.

villages.name: Serre Chevalier 1400
villages.character: Main resort base, ski-in/ski-out, shops and restaurants

villages.name: La Salle-les-Alpes
villages.character: Village base with good access to both Briancon and main lifts

honest_drawbacks: Southern Alps = less snow than northern Alps
Some sectors lack tree cover above tree line
